ablation_plan.expected: on envs where the full rule HOLDS: which of the three sub-mechanisms carries the win. On envs where it BREAKS: which sub-mechanism fails (e.g. success detector never fires -> all variants identical to full).
ablation_plan.note: descriptive mechanism evidence, not gated; per-seed WIN uses the same env-class gate; ordering vs the full rule is the diagnostic
ablation_plan.seeds: first 2 of the env's seed set; frozen totals reused (frozen is variant-independent)

baselines.frozen: same ReturnConditionedEpisodicArbitrator with frozen=True (gains pinned at 1.0) -- paired per seed (identical env seed, identical specialists)

config.arbitrator: ReturnConditionedEpisodicArbitrator (prototypes/architecture-a/attention_ecr_repro.py; the EXP-FP-0080 independent ECR reimplementation; module UNTOUCHED by this experiment)
config.branch_prior_justification: no t=0 branch decision exists; every movement tick is a path-branching decision. Result is insensitive to this choice (only shaping-classified ticks update); verified by a one-seed re-run with branch_channels={'north'}.
config.independence_note: ECR rule and module unchanged from EXP-FP-0080; only the task environment varies. attention.py, tick.py, attention_ecr_repro.py byte-identical (G0 checks).
config.no_tuning: all ECR params held identical to EXP-FP-0080; no tuning on confirmatory seeds
config.specialists: neutral (0.5 + noise(0.05) on every channel; bandit isolation, K5 P1 / EXP-FP-0080 identical)
config.ticks_per_seed_arm: 8 * 100 (fixed loop, episodes auto-reset; early terminations may yield more env episodes)

expected_mechanism_note: ECR's terminal-success detector (r>=1.0) cannot fire: the goal tick pays -0.02+1.00=0.98 <1.0, so terminal success is ABSORBED AS A SHAPING TICK; the success lock-in (branch+progress cap-set) never fires; true episode boundaries leak across env episodes until the max_steps truncation reset. If learned==frozen exactly, that is the finding (detector misfire), not a failed run.

frozen_gates.G0: canonical files byte-identical pre/post (attention.py, tick.py, attention_ecr_repro.py, k5_multitask_generalization.py, all envs/)
frozen_gates.G1: fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new code (driver + writer)
frozen_gates.G2: determinism: recompute first seed's learned arm through the identical driver path, exact match (1e-12)
frozen_gates.G3: hash-chained receipt via experiments/harness.py write_receipt; on ReceiptExistsError claim a fresh ID, never force
frozen_gates.G4: nothing pushed to git; all artifacts local

gate: HOLDS iff WIN on 4/4 fresh seeds {87101..87104}.
gate_adaptation: PREREGISTERED ADAPTATION with justification: the canonical R = total(learned)/total(frozen) gate is INVALID here because per-tick rewards are negative (step -0.02, bump -0.05): R is a ratio of negatives, so R>=1.30 would mean learned is MORE negative (worse). The task objective is goal-reaching, so the gate compares goal-reaching episodes per arm per seed.
hypothesis: H1: ECR learned gains beat frozen gains on grid_world: learned reaches the goal in strictly more episodes than frozen on 4/4 fresh seeds.
metric: goal_episodes(learned) vs goal_episodes(frozen) per seed; per-seed WIN iff learned > frozen (strict). Total return (less negative = better) reported as secondary.
null: H0: learned does not reach the goal in more episodes than frozen on >=1 seed -> ECR does not generalize to grid_world -> mechanistic bound recorded.
preregistered_before: any execution of the EXP-FP-012x battery driver on these seeds; module/driver written before, no confirmatory data seen
rng_policy: seeded env RNG only (new_rng via env.reset with preregistered seeds x1000+e); neutral_specialists seeded per channel; no random.* in measurement code except seeded RNG declared here
